name: hangrygrotesk
description: A geometric stencil display font suite (Grotesk, Serif, Pixel, Dotted, Diamond) across 9 weights (100–900), available as OTF, TTF, Variable, WOFF, and WOFF2.

scripts.build: python3 -c 'import ufo2ft, pathops' 2>/dev/null && python3 src/build_font.py || .venv/bin/python3 src/build_font.py
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --follow-tags
